skill_name: Summarize the current state of the European Union
workflow: The European Union (EU) is an economic and political union of 27 member states located primarily in Europe. The EU had a population of almost 450 million people in 2020 and a gross domestic product of over 19 trillion euros. The primary goal of the EU is to promote economic growth and social progress.
